text:
deploy-bot: [deploy] rollout v2.14.0 -> prod started by @anya
anya: kicking off post-deploy smoke and synth checks now (canary bucket A)
deploy-bot: preflight OK, canary instances spun up, synthetic probes scheduled
mike_s: seeing intermittent 502/503 from embed-synth in eu-west1, p95 spiking to ~480ms on a couple probes
anya: ugh, can you paste the probe output? which probe ID?
mike_s: probe ids: synth-embed-eu-01..03, snippet:
```
2026-03-21T15:02:12Z synth-embed-eu-02 200 0.22s
2026-03-21T15:02:14Z synth-embed-eu-01 502 0.03s
2026-03-21T15:02:20Z synth-embed-eu-03 503 0.01s
```
ben: that pattern looks like a deadman/fallback path — maybe prefix cache miss + model fallback to CPU path causing quick 5xxs then retries
anya: I'm pausing the rollout at 30% canary. Hold further traffic.
derek: +1 to pause. Suggest we pin eu-west1 back to v2.13.3 while we triage to avoid customer impact in that region
anya: agreed. We'll do a regional pin and collect traces. @deploy-bot, pin eu-west1 to v2.13.3
deploy-bot: executing routing pin -> eu-west1 pinned to v2.13.3 (partial traffic re-route) :white_check_mark:
mike_s: after pin, quick re-run of probes shows p95 ~220ms and no 5xx in the sample window
san: filing a follow-up ticket and adding to release notes
anya: created INF-4281: "post-deploy synth observed transient 502/503 in EU; regional pin to v2.13.3; investigate cache warmup/path to CPU fallback" — added to changelog and release-notes draft
sre-oncall: I'll kick off the runbook (postdeploy-smoke) and check host/GPU metrics + kernel OOM logs, starting now
derek: capture flame graphs and kv-cache hit rates; also check rollout autoscaler logs for rapid scaling events
anya: decision: keep global rollout paused for next change window (3h) while derek+mike_s investigate. Re-run synthetic suite after cache warmup and memory checks.
mike_s: noted — will post trace links and heap profiles in the ticket once ready
anya: thanks everyone. deploy-bot, schedule a recheck in 2h and ping eng-releases when complete
deploy-bot: recheck scheduled in 2h; will notify channel on status change :bell:
anya: closing the hold for now — updates only in thread. Will update release notes once we have root cause. :thumbsup:
